question: Should the twelve ICU replay beds be scored by a single tuned LightGBM over all 40 CinC variables instead of the shipped 7-vital stacked detector?

evidence_so_far.GENESIS locked test (8,067 patients, sco: tuned single LightGBM, all 40 variables: AUROC 0.862 (hour-matched 0.816) vs the shipped stack's architecture refitted on the same patients 0.805; delta +0.0565 [+0.0456, +0.0682] (docs/GENESIS.md section 5)
evidence_so_far.why it was never served: the locked run saved scores, not a model (artifacts/genesis/locked/head_direct_slow.npy)

incumbent: the DEPLOYED artifact patient:hgb+hgb2+et+lr+xgb@utility~centred#7fbbdd0ad322 (artifacts/gbm_wearable.joblib), scored not refitted, read at its shipped operating point HIGH 0.0525
candidate: LightGBM, challenge label, GENESIS default FeatureSpec (510 causal features over all 40 variables, missing kept missing), params of genesis_spec.json heads.direct (lr 0.02, 31 leaves, min_data_in_leaf 800, feature_fraction 0.3, bagging_fraction 0.7, lambda_l2 10; LGB_BASE otherwise), early stopping and a Platt map on a 10% patient-held-out slice of the training patients (genesis.stack.fit_head), seed 99
training_patients: exactly the shipped detector's 24,206 training patients (promotion_split of artifacts/detector_manifest.json, digest 7fbbdd0ad322), so the bundled demo sample and the holdout stay unseen by both models. The GENESIS locked 8,067 are not touched.
judged_patients: the 8,062-patient promotion holdout (every hour, challenge label). For alarm decisions it is split by patient (stratified_group_split, seed 43, as promote_frontier does): the candidate's operating point is derived on half A (operating_point.derive, constrained, max false-alarm rate 0.15) and both detectors are judged on half B, each at its own threshold.

predictions.delta vs incumbent: paired patient bootstrap (1,000 draws) lower bound > 0
predictions.alarm budget: detection inside a 15% alarm budget on half B: no significant regression (paired bootstrap upper bound >= 0)

decision_rule: Ship iff all of: holdout AUROC >= 0.83, delta lower bound > 0, no significant regression at the 15% budget, and an operating point exists under the 15% cap. Shipped as artifacts/gbm_icu.joblib with artifacts/operating_point_icu.json, both stamped with the training digest; it scores the ICU replay beds only, the live room keeps the wearable stack. Otherwise nothing is written but the result.
disclosures: This holdout has judged the incumbent's promotion and the ward before/after (artifacts/ward_risk.json); this is its first look at any all-variable model.
The all-variable model's advantage is already known from the locked set; this test is whether it holds on these patients for a fit on 24k rather than 32k, and whether its alarms are at least as good.
rules: No gate, parameter or code path changes after the run.
The result is reported whatever it is. If refused, this candidate is not re-tested on these patients.
